_comment: Critic/outlet tenure flags checked by hand and found correct (BRO-5222). key = <showId>/<file>#<kind>:<criticSlug> (as printed by scripts/audit-critic-tenure.js); evidence = a link showing the byline at that outlet. maxUnresolved is a ratchet: tests/acceptance/critic-tenure-flags.test.mjs fails if unresolved flags exceed it, so lower it as flags are fixed or reviewed (BRO-5232 takes it to 0).
